generator-software 1.0.0 — initial release

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts or uploaded files (MP4, MOV, PNG, TXT, up to 500MB)
- Serve marketers and content creators with fast, server-side video compositing—no manual editing or installation required
- Automatic cloud handling: connect, upload, edit, export videos directly via text instructions
- Built-in session/token management and simple credit system for anonymous or registered users
- Supports a wide variety of output and input formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, gif, png, mp3, more)
- Error handling, session state management, and common video editing workflows are fully integrated
